Thanks Aditya — quick plan and concrete numbers below so you can pass to FinTrust. I'm keeping language conservative so legal has room for negotiation.

SOC 2 status: audit field testing complete (closed 2026-04-30). We can deliver control narratives + sample evidence exports by 20 May. Type II report expected Q4 2026.

SIG/CAIQ: we'll export the CAIQ JSON + a short gap log. Target delivery: 20 May 2026. We'll flag any medium/high gaps and propose compensating controls.

DPA / retention (proposed options):
- Request/response logs (hosted API): default retention 30 days. Enterprise add-on: configurable 90/365/1095 days (90d / 1y / 3y). Private deployments: customer-controlled retention.
- Embeddings / persisted vectors: not stored by default. If a customer elects to persist embeddings, retention is configurable; default persist retention is 365 days.
- Backups / snapshots: incremental snapshots retained 14 days; full backups retained 90 days (default). Extended retention available on request.
- Deletion SLA: policy-level deletion request acknowledged within 2 business days; full cryptographic wipe and confirmation within 30 calendar days for hosted accounts (faster in Private deployments).
- Key management: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) in enterprise plans; destruction of keys is used as an additional deletion mechanism when requested.

Evidence handling & delivery:
- We'll provide a shared secure Drive with an index and temporary read-only links (expires 30 days) to the sample artifacts.

Suggested acceptance language for MAP: "Security gate satisfied when control narratives + sample artifacts for all in-scope controls are provided AND customer signs acceptance that no critical gaps remain after CAIQ review within the review window. DPA signed or marked for legal escalation by the DPA deadline."

I'll package the CAIQ export and the evidence folder by EOD 20 May. Priyom: can you prepare a succinct DPA redline with the retention options above? If FinTrust pushes for shorter deletion SLA, flag that for legal.

Rishi
Lead, Applied Security — Redwood Inference
